semantics.params: Name string selects the rank category.

semantics.summary: Sets the player's mission rank for the named category.
Adds a notoriety value to the first race's notoriety towards the second race.
semantics.effects: Changes race notoriety. Generic version changes only the player's entry; amount x25/10 to percent step, own race ignored.
semantics.edge: Races in the no-change mask are skipped.

semantics.summary: Adds raw notoriety points from one race toward another, with bonus and rank handling.
semantics.params: actor race, target race, raw points
semantics.effects: Notoriety of the first race toward the target changes, may trigger rank cutscene/achievements.
semantics.edge: Only works when the actor is an AI race and the target is the player race (10): other targets, fixed-notoriety races and the player race stub return without change. Not grouped (arg3=0), so rank change is shown.

semantics.summary: Returns the notoriety value needed to reach a title level.
Applies a table of notoriety changes to the player (grouped, no rank cutscene).
semantics.params: script table; entry key 10 holds race -> {type,value}
semantics.effects: Calls AddNotorietyPointsRaw(player, value, grouped) on each race, then UpdateGroupedNotoriety.
semantics.edge: Does nothing if table or sub-table is missing or empty.

commands.syntax: $ret = advance notoriety by percentage: notoriety=<Var/Number>, level=<Var/Number>, percentage=<Var/Number>
commands.text: %0advance notoriety by percentage: notoriety=%1, level=%2, percentage=%3

semantics.summary: Returns the notoriety points needed to advance by a percentage of a title level.
semantics.returns: int points; null for level <=-5 or >=10
semantics.edge: Percent above 100 recurses over further levels.

semantics.summary: Reads a text from the game text pages by page and id.
semantics.returns: string (5) after format conversion; null if text missing.
semantics.edge: Missing text: null.

commands.syntax: $ret =|if read text: page id=<Var/Number>, from <Var/Number> to <Var/Number> to array, include empty=<Var/Number>
commands.text: %0read text: page id=%1, from %2 to %3 to array, include empty=%4

semantics.summary: Reads all texts of a text page for ids from..to and returns them as an array of strings.
semantics.returns: Array (21) of {5,string} pairs, one per text; null if the range has no texts.
semantics.params: Page id, from-id, to-id inclusive, include-empty flag: when 0 only ids that exist (SE_ExistsText) are loaded, when nonzero every id in range is read. Texts pass through SE_ConvertFormatString.
semantics.edge: Not available for page 2003 (per handler comment). Count is computed first; if count < 1 returns null. Large ranges allocate 2*(to-from+1) cells.

commands.syntax: $ret =|if read text: page id=<Var/Number>, id=<Var/Number> exists

semantics.summary: Tests whether a text with the given page id and text id exists.
semantics.returns: Int 1 if the text exists, else null (false).
semantics.edge: Returns null rather than 0 when missing; page 2003 not readable via this command.

semantics.summary: Formats a string like sprintf using the given format string and up to five values.
semantics.params: fmt is the format string; each of the 5 values is first converted to a string by DataTypeToString, so use %s for all (numeric formatting like %d is not applied to the original value).
semantics.edge: Unused value slots are null and render as their DataTypeToString of null.

semantics.summary: Formats a string like sprintf, taking the format string from text page/id, with up to five values.
semantics.params: pageid, textid select the format text via SE_ReadText; values are converted to strings by DataTypeToString first.
semantics.edge: Missing text gives whatever SE_ReadText returns for it (empty/default).

semantics.summary: Loads text page <id> (UiTextFonts.LoadText) so its texts become readable.
semantics.params: Only ids 1..9999 are accepted; others are ignored.
semantics.effects: Loads a text page into memory.
semantics.edge: Out-of-range id silently ignored.

semantics.summary: Returns the current game (text) language id.
Returns the current speech language id.

commands.syntax: $ret = register hotkey <Var/String> to call script <Script Name>

semantics.summary: Registers a custom hotkey (key name string) that calls the given script when pressed.
semantics.returns: Int hotkey id from InputMapper.RegisterCustomHotkey; null if the script does not exist.
semantics.params: Hotkey is a string; script name must exist (ScriptDatabase.FindScript). Second argument to the registrar is fixed 0.
semantics.effects: Adds a custom hotkey binding in InputMapper.
semantics.edge: Missing script -> null, no hotkey.

commands.syntax: $ret = register hotkey <Var/String> to call script name <Var/String>

semantics.summary: Registers a custom hotkey calling a script given by name string (variable form of 1100).
semantics.returns: Int hotkey id; null if the script is not found.
semantics.params: Script name as a string value.
semantics.edge: Missing script -> null.

commands.syntax: $ret = register hotkey: page=<Var/Number> id=<Var/Number>, to call script <Script Name>
commands.text: %0register hotkey: page=%1 id=%2, to call script %3

semantics.summary: Registers a custom hotkey whose label is a text page/id, calling the given script.
semantics.returns: Int hotkey id from RegisterCustomHotkeyTextID; null if the script does not exist.
semantics.params: page and text id give the displayed name in the controls menu.
semantics.effects: Adds a custom hotkey binding with text-id label.
semantics.edge: Missing script -> null.

commands.syntax: $ret = register hotkey: page=<Var/Number> id=<Var/Number>, to call script name <Var/String>
commands.text: %0register hotkey: page=%1 id=%2, to call script name %3

semantics.summary: Same as 1601 but the script is given as a name string.
semantics.returns: Int hotkey id; null if the script is not found.
semantics.params: page, text id for the label; script name string.
semantics.effects: Adds a custom hotkey binding with text-id label.
semantics.edge: Missing script -> null.

semantics.summary: Removes a custom hotkey registered earlier.
semantics.params: Hotkey id returned by the register commands; 0 is ignored.
semantics.edge: Id 0 ignored.

semantics.summary: Looks up the id of a custom hotkey by its script.
semantics.returns: Int hotkey id from InputMapper.FindCustomHotkeyID (0 if none); always returns an int.
semantics.edge: Not found -> 0 (so as a condition it is false).

semantics.summary: Looks up the id of a custom hotkey by script name string (variable form of 1602).
semantics.edge: Not found -> 0.

commands.syntax: $ret = register hotkey event script: script=<Script Name>, type=<Var/Number>, page id=<Var/Number>, text id=<Var/Number>, key=<Var/Number>
commands.text: %0register hotkey event script: script=%1, type=%2, page id=%3, text id=%4, key=%5

semantics.summary: Registers a custom hotkey that starts a script when pressed. Event variant: script receives pressed/released/short/long/double events.
semantics.returns: int hotkey id; null if the script does not exist
semantics.params: script name, type (stored), page id, text id, key (>=1536 to force a key, else a free id)
semantics.effects: Adds an entry to the custom hotkey table (kind 2, event flag 1).
semantics.edge: Re-registering the same script name reuses its hotkey id. The key only counts if its type is int and nonzero. KC argument names (defaultKey) look misnamed: page id is stored second and text id in the entry.

commands.syntax: $ret = register hotkey: script=<Script Name>, type=<Var/Number>, page id=<Var/Number>, text id=<Var/Number>, menu=<Var/Boolean>, key=<Var/Number>
commands.text: %0register hotkey: script=%1, type=%2, page id=%3, text id=%4, menu=%5, key=%6

semantics.summary: Registers a custom hotkey that starts a script when pressed. Plain variant (menu flag, no event flag): script is started with the key id.
semantics.returns: int hotkey id; null if the script does not exist
semantics.params: script name, type, page id, text id, menu flag (hotkey usable in menus), key
semantics.effects: Adds an entry to the custom hotkey table (kind 2, event flag 0).
semantics.edge: Same key rules as the event variant; menu flag restricts the contexts to 1022 instead of 2.

semantics.summary: Registers a custom hotkey that starts a script when pressed. Same as the event variant, but the script name is a string value instead of a script reference.
semantics.returns: int hotkey id; null if the script does not exist
semantics.params: script name string, type, page id, text id, key

semantics.summary: Registers a custom hotkey that starts a script when pressed. Same as the plain variant, but the script name is a string.
semantics.returns: int hotkey id; null if the script does not exist
semantics.params: script name string, type, page id, text id, menu flag, key

semantics.summary: Sets a named local variable on the target object's script.
semantics.edge: Null object: ignored.

semantics.summary: Reads a named local variable from the object.
semantics.returns: stored value with original type; null if the variable does not exist.
semantics.edge: Null object: null.

semantics.summary: Sets a named global variable.
semantics.effects: ScriptObject.SetScriptVariable(name, pair) (global, saved in the savegame).

semantics.summary: Reads a named global variable.
semantics.returns: stored value with its type; null if not set.

commands.syntax: $ret =|if <RefObj> -> get all local variable keys, starting with=<Var/String>
commands.text: %1%0 get all local variable keys, starting with=%2

semantics.summary: Returns names of an object's script-local variables that start with a prefix.
semantics.returns: Array of strings (5); null if there are none.
semantics.params: RefObj is the script/object whose variables are read; prefix string.
semantics.edge: Empty result gives null.

commands.syntax: $ret =|if get all global variable keys, starting with=<Var/String>
commands.text: %0get all global variable keys, starting with=%1

semantics.summary: Returns names of global script variables (class 702) starting with a prefix.
semantics.returns: Array of strings; null if none.
semantics.edge: Empty -> null.

semantics.summary: Returns names of an object's local script variables matching a regular expression.
semantics.returns: Array of strings; null if none.
semantics.edge: Empty -> null.

semantics.summary: Returns names of global script variables matching a regular expression.
semantics.returns: Array of strings; null if none.
semantics.edge: Empty -> null.

semantics.summary: Reloads the ship boarding table from addon2/types/TBoarding.txt.
semantics.effects: Rebuilds the class, race and ship-type boarding tables; falls back to built-in defaults if the file is missing or empty.

semantics.summary: Sets the boarding table row for a ship class (or for a class of one race) from 7 values and a flag.
semantics.params: race (null = for all races), class, 7 numbers (fields 0..6), launch-marines flag (field 11). Boarding row fields: 0 deck number, 1 hull defence, 2 base defence, 3 hacking roll, 4 hacking base, 5 shield threshold, 6 volume, 7..10 loot/marine values, 11 launch-marines flag, 12 deck kill rate.
semantics.effects: Replaces the row; fields 7..10 are kept from the old row (defaults 20,0,field6,20).
semantics.edge: Race path writes g59[race][class] even if the race table does not exist yet (assignment into a missing table does nothing).
semantics.bug: New row has only 12 cells: field 12 (deck kill rate read by GetBoardingDeckKillRate) is dropped, so it is null/0 after this command.

semantics.summary: Sets the boarding table row for one ship type from 7 values and a flag.
semantics.params: ship type, 7 numbers (fields 0..6), flag (field 11). Boarding row fields: 0 deck number, 1 hull defence, 2 base defence, 3 hacking roll, 4 hacking base, 5 shield threshold, 6 volume, 7..10 loot/marine values, 11 launch-marines flag, 12 deck kill rate.
semantics.bug: Same as 2158: row rebuilt with 12 cells, field 12 (deck kill rate) lost.

semantics.summary: Sets fields 7..10 of an existing class (or race+class) boarding row.
semantics.params: race (null = class table), class, 4 numbers for fields 7,8,9,10
semantics.effects: Writes the four fields in place.
semantics.edge: Does nothing if the row does not exist.

bug.note: Only 4 of the 8 numbers reach the boarding table; the last 4 are ignored.

semantics.summary: Sets fields 7..10 of an existing ship-type boarding row.
semantics.effects: Writes the four fields in place.
semantics.edge: Does nothing if no row exists for that ship type.
semantics.bug: S51 confirmed: signature lists 7 numbers and a boolean, but the handler reads only cells 1..10 (type + 4 numbers); the last 3 numbers and the boolean are ignored.

semantics.summary: Removes the boarding row of a class (or of a class for one race).
semantics.effects: Removes the row; drops the race table when empty.

semantics.summary: Removes the boarding row of a ship type.
Reads a text file from addon2/types and returns its lines.
semantics.returns: string array (one entry per line); null if the file is missing or empty
semantics.params: file name; characters \ / : are stripped (no sub-folders)
semantics.edge: Splits on CR LF only; goes through the game virtual file system, so catalogue files are found.

semantics.summary: Reads a whole file from data/<directory>/ on disk.
semantics.edge: Disk only (no catalogue). Non-string name or directory is ignored. Empty directory means data/.

commands.syntax: write file data: filename=<Var/String>, directory=<Var/String>, data=<Var/String>
commands.text: write file data: filename=%0, directory=%1, data=%2

semantics.summary: Writes a string to data/<directory>/<file>, creating the folders.
semantics.params: file name, directory, data (any type, converted to string)
semantics.effects: Creates data and data/<dir> with SE_MakeDir (relative to the Egosoft user dir) and writes the file with SE_WriteFile (disk only).
semantics.edge: Names are stripped of \ / :, so no path escape. MakeDir is user-dir relative while the file path is data/..., which may differ from where ReadFile looks; not verified.

commands.syntax: $ret =|if get files in directory: <Var/String> search pattern=<Var/String>

semantics.summary: Lists the entries of data/<directory>/ (optional pattern).
semantics.returns: string array; null if the directory is missing or empty
semantics.edge: Removes the '.' and '..' entries; subdirectories are included. Folder name stripped of \ / :.

semantics.summary: Parses an XML string into a node.
semantics.returns: xml node (type 38); null if the text is not valid XML
semantics.edge: Node layout: [tag, attributes table or 0, child1, child2, ...]; children are nodes or text strings.

semantics.summary: Returns the number of children of an XML node.
semantics.edge: Computes array size - 2; not checked for a non-node value.

semantics.summary: Returns one child of an XML node by index.
semantics.returns: node (38) for an element, string (5) for text, else null
semantics.edge: No bounds check: a negative index reads the tag or the attribute table, an index past the end gives null.

semantics.summary: Returns the tag name (first cell) of an XML node.
Tests whether an XML node has an attribute.
semantics.edge: Nodes without attributes have 0 there; the test is guarded.

semantics.summary: Returns the value of an XML node attribute.
semantics.returns: int if the attribute is numeric, otherwise string; null if missing
semantics.edge: The attribute table may be 0 for nodes without attributes; indexing it is not guarded.

semantics.summary: Returns the first child element of an XML node with a given tag name.
Evaluates an expression and stores or tests its result; handled by the expression evaluator rather than a case.
Increments the variable by 1.
semantics.returns: int, previous value +1 stored in the variable.
semantics.effects: variable = variable + 1, type forced to int.
semantics.edge: Non-int variable is reinterpreted as an int value (no check).

semantics.summary: Decrements the variable by 1.
semantics.returns: int, previous value -1 stored in the variable.

semantics.summary: Waits the given number of milliseconds; can be cut short by an interrupt.
semantics.returns: int result of TI_WaitForInterrupt (0 normal, nonzero if interrupted).
semantics.effects: suspends the task until time passes or an interrupt arrives.

semantics.summary: Waits a random time between min and max milliseconds; interruptible.
semantics.params: ms; the random span is max-min, forced to at least 1.
semantics.effects: suspends until the time passes or an interrupt.
semantics.edge: max <= min waits min plus 0 (span 1).

semantics.summary: Wakes all tasks waiting for a script interrupt with the given id.
semantics.params: interrupt id (>0; the engine key is 10000+id)
semantics.effects: TI_Interrupt(10000+id): tasks in the matching wait resume with the remaining time.
semantics.edge: Id <= 0 is ignored.

semantics.summary: Waits until another script signals the interrupt id or the timeout (ms) runs out.
semantics.returns: int: 0 on timeout, remaining time (ms) when interrupted; null if id <= 0
semantics.edge: Id <= 0 does not wait and returns null.

semantics.summary: Returns a fresh unique interrupt id.
Returns a random integer from 0 to N-1.
Returns a random integer from min to max-1.
Comment line; ignored by the interpreter.
Enables or disables signal/interrupt handling for this task.
Tests whether signal/interrupt handling is on for this task.
semantics.edge: Returns null (not 0) when off.

semantics.summary: Wraps a value's type as a datatype value.
semantics.returns: datatype (20) holding the type code of the argument.
semantics.edge: Never used in stock scripts.

semantics.summary: Tests whether the type of a value equals the given datatype.
semantics.returns: int 1 if type matches, else null.
semantics.params: Compares type code of the value with the datatype value.

semantics.summary: Reinterprets a value as another script data type without converting it.
semantics.returns: same value, tagged with the given type
semantics.edge: No conversion or validation: the cell is only retagged.

commands.syntax: $ret =|if state of news article: page=<Var/Number> id=<Var/Number>

semantics.summary: Returns the state of a news (BBS) article identified by text page and line id.
semantics.returns: Int: article state (0 when the article is missing or off).
semantics.edge: Unknown article -> 0.

commands.syntax: set state of news article page=<Var/Number> id=<Var/Number> to <Var/Number>
commands.text: set state of news article page=%0 id=%1 to %2

semantics.summary: Sets the state of a news (BBS) article identified by page and id.
semantics.params: State > 0 means active; the valid-article counter is kept in step.
semantics.effects: Changes article state and BbsNews valid-article count.
semantics.edge: Unknown article is ignored.

semantics.summary: True if the real (system) date has the given month and day.
semantics.returns: Int 1 if today's system month/day equal the arguments, else null.
semantics.params: month, day as numbers; compared as strings 'MM/DD' against SE_TimeString('%m/%d', SE_Time()), i.e. real-world clock, not game time.
semantics.edge: Year not checked.

semantics.summary: Returns the in-game time counter of the player (gPlayerRace.GetAge), in seconds.
semantics.edge: This is game time (age counter m8, used e.g. with '-3600' for one hour), not real play time (GetPlayingTime, m11, is written to savegame info as realtime).

semantics.summary: Returns the game clock.
semantics.edge: Game ms scaled by time warp (EngineConfig+0x718).

semantics.summary: Returns the real (not warped) elapsed time.
semantics.edge: Unit not traced past the name; EngineConfig+0x720.

semantics.summary: Returns the system clock reading.
Compares two times and returns their difference.
semantics.returns: int, second time minus first time
semantics.edge: Handler passes the arguments to TI_CmpTime in reverse order, so the result is param2 - param1, 32-bit wrapping.

semantics.summary: Adds a number of time units to a time value.
Returns the start day of the game.
Sets the start day of the game.
True if a given plot state flag (0..255) of a plot is set.
semantics.params: plot number, flag 0..255; each plot owns 8 words of 32 flags.
semantics.edge: flag >= 256 returns false.

semantics.summary: Returns the game-time of the last savegame load.
semantics.returns: Int: gPlayerRace.GetLastLoadTime (game-age seconds at last load).
semantics.edge: Value set from GetAge at load.

semantics.summary: Returns the maximum of two to five numbers.
semantics.params: First two values always used; values 3-5 only counted if integer-typed (type 4), other types are ignored; shares code with 1597.
semantics.edge: Non-integer values 1 and 2 are taken without type check.

semantics.summary: Returns the minimum of two to five numbers.
semantics.params: Same operand rules as 1457: values 3-5 only if integer-typed.
semantics.edge: cmdId selects min vs max.

commands.syntax: $ret = get colour code: red=<Var/Number> green=<Var/Number> blue=<Var/Number> transparency=<Var/Number>
commands.text: %0get colour code: red=%1 green=%2 blue=%3 transparency=%4

semantics.summary: Builds a colour code from red, green, blue and transparency.
semantics.returns: Int ARGB: ((255-transparency)<<24)|(r<<16)|(g<<8)|b, each component masked to 0..255.
semantics.params: transparency 0 = opaque, 255 = invisible (alpha stored inverted); values wrap with &255.
semantics.edge: Result is a signed 32-bit int for alpha >= 128 opaque.

commands.syntax: $ret = get global parameter value: parameter=<Var/Global Parameter> default=<Var/Number>

semantics.summary: Reads a global game parameter by index, returning a default when the parameter value is unset.
semantics.returns: Int from SA_GetGlobalParameter(name, default); null if the index is not in the parameter name table.
semantics.params: parameter = index into SA_GetGlobalParameterNames; default is passed to the native.
semantics.edge: Unknown index -> null.

semantics.summary: Extracts a byte (bits 16-23) from a packed colour number.
semantics.edge: Pure bit arithmetic, no type check; used as a condition false when 0.

semantics.summary: Extracts a byte (bits 8-15) from a packed colour number.
semantics.edge: Pure bit arithmetic, no type check; used as a condition false when 0.

semantics.summary: Extracts a byte (bits 0-7) from a packed colour number.
semantics.edge: Pure bit arithmetic, no type check; used as a condition false when 0.

semantics.summary: Extracts a byte (bits 24-31) from a packed colour number.
semantics.edge: Pure bit arithmetic, no type check; used as a condition false when 0.

semantics.summary: Returns an array of all 30 race ids.
semantics.edge: Includes the player race (10) and unused slots.

commands.syntax: $ret = get race array: include fixed=<Var/Boolean>, include corporations=<Var/Boolean>, include player=<Var/Boolean>
commands.text: %0get race array: include fixed=%1, include corporations=%2, include player=%3

semantics.summary: Returns an array of race ids filtered by three flags.
semantics.params: include fixed races, include corporations (class 407), include player race (10)
semantics.edge: Excluded: fixed races when flag off, corporations when off, id 10 when player flag off.

semantics.summary: Registers a drone ship type as carried by a carrier ship type.

semantics.edge: Re-adding with a new carrier replaces the old mapping.

semantics.summary: Removes a drone ship type from the carrier registry.
semantics.effects: Deletes the mapping and decrements the carrier's drone count.
semantics.edge: Unknown type ignored.

semantics.summary: Returns the id of the game start (scenario) this game began with.
Returns the group id of the game start.
semantics.edge: Lazily reads the id from the launch parameter if unset.

semantics.summary: Returns the mod name text shown on screen.
Sets the mod name text shown on screen.
semantics.params: any value (converted to a string); null or 0 clears

semantics.summary: Plays a sound sample by id.
semantics.edge: Silently skipped while a cutscene movie is playing.

commands.syntax: play sample: incoming transmission <Var/Number>, from object <Value>
commands.text: play sample: incoming transmission %0, from object %1

semantics.summary: Plays an incoming-transmission sample with the given object as the sender.
semantics.edge: Skipped during cutscene movies.

semantics.summary: Makes the object send an audio message to the player.
semantics.edge: Blocked when client state bit 32 is set or a cutscene movie plays.

commands.syntax: send incoming message <Var/String> to player: type:<Var/Number>, display it=<Var/Boolean>
commands.text: send incoming message %0 to player: type:%1, display it=%2

semantics.summary: Sends a text message to the player's incoming-messages area, optionally also writing it to the logbook.

semantics.effects: Client.IncomingMessageWithFilter(text, 0, popup?1:0, type, 1); if the fourth flag is set also gPlayerRace.LogString.
semantics.edge: Message is passed raw to the client (only the logbook copy is converted with DataTypeToString), so a non-string value is not formatted; message is queued 3 s while the game is frozen.

semantics.summary: Sends an incoming message from an object with the given text.
semantics.params: temporary flag: nonzero uses message flags 16, 0 uses 8.

commands.syntax: send incoming question <Var/String> to player: callback=<Script Name>
commands.text: send incoming question %0 to player: callback=%1

semantics.summary: Sends an incoming question to the player; the answer calls the callback script.
semantics.params: question text; callback script must exist. Title text id 4289 is fixed.
semantics.edge: Missing callback script -> nothing happens.

commands.syntax: send incoming question <Var/String> to player: callback=<Script Name> flags=<Var/Number>
commands.text: send incoming question %0 to player: callback=%1 flags=%2

semantics.summary: Same as 212 with an extra flags/argument value.
semantics.params: flags passed as third argument to IncomingQuestion; meaning not verified.
semantics.edge: Missing script -> nothing.

semantics.summary: Serialises an object reference to the string '$#<id>$'.
semantics.edge: No null/existence check; null object gives '$#0$' style string.

semantics.summary: Speaks a voice text (page/id) with a priority and returns the speak result.

semantics.params: priority capped to 99. With the START form (return var -2147483646) the speech runs in a forked task and the script does not block.
semantics.effects: Plays a speech line; blocks until it is spoken (non-START form).
semantics.edge: Nothing spoken when Client.GetKilled().

commands.syntax: display subtitle text: text=<Var/String> duration=<Var/Number> ms
commands.text: display subtitle text: text=%0 duration=%1 ms

semantics.summary: Shows subtitle text for a duration in ms.
semantics.params: duration in ms; if the duration is null or 0 it is computed as GetTextDisplayDuration(text,100)+500.

semantics.summary: Returns the name of an object as a text array.
semantics.returns: Array: {7,sectorNameID} for sectors, {13,textID} for class 9001 objects, else the object's GetNameArray(); null if none.
semantics.edge: Nonexistent object -> null.

semantics.summary: Returns the name text id of a ware.
semantics.returns: Int text id, null if ware is 0.
semantics.edge: Ware 0 -> null.

semantics.summary: Speaks an array of text lines with a priority.
semantics.returns: Int result of SpeakArrayWithPriority; nothing when the player is dead or the array is empty.
semantics.params: Input is a script array of {type,value} pairs; only the values (odd indices) are spoken. Priority capped to 99. START form (return var -2147483646) forks.
semantics.effects: Plays speech; blocks until spoken unless START.
semantics.edge: Nothing when Client.GetKilled().

commands.syntax: <RefObj> ->play pilot speaker comm message: id=<Var/Number>, prio=<Var/Number>
commands.text: %0play pilot speaker comm message: id=%1, prio=%2

semantics.summary: Plays a voice message of the object's pilot (a speaker comm line) with the given text id and priority.
semantics.effects: Client.PlayMessageWithPrioAndFace(object, id, prio, 0): disables fast forward, plays the pilot's face and voice.
semantics.edge: Object without a pilot face may give a default face; ignored when the client is shut down.

semantics.summary: Adjusts a speak array so its last two cells name the object's sector.
semantics.params: object must be a sector; speak array of pairs

semantics.edge: No class check: on a non-HQ object the HQ method is not defined, so the result is null/0 (like a missing object).

semantics.summary: Tests whether the given ship type can be reverse-engineered at all.
semantics.edge: No class check: on a non-HQ object the HQ method is not defined, so the result is null/0 (like a missing object).

semantics.summary: Switches the HQ's production/repair/reverse/recycle queues on or off.
semantics.edge: No class check.

semantics.summary: Returns the list of ware keys the HQ has blueprints for.
semantics.edge: Keys of the blueprint table. No class check: on a non-HQ object the HQ method is not defined, so the result is null/0 (like a missing object).

semantics.summary: Returns the ship currently being repaired at the HQ.
semantics.returns: ship (65542), null when idle or the ship no longer exists.

semantics.summary: Returns the HQ repair queue as an array of ships.
semantics.returns: array (21) of ships, null when empty.

semantics.summary: Adds a ship to the HQ repair queue.
semantics.edge: Only if the ship is not in the REVERSE queue (IsReverseItem is tested, not IsRepairItem; probably a copy-paste from 1691) and CanBeRepaired(ship, 1). Adding the same ship twice is not blocked by this handler.
semantics.bug: Duplicate test uses IsReverseItem(ship) instead of IsRepairItem(ship) (same in AP). Stock-script effect unverified.

semantics.summary: Removes a ship from the HQ repair queue.
semantics.edge: No-op if not queued.

semantics.summary: Returns the repair time for a ship type at the given percentage.
semantics.edge: Passes the raw ship type cell (not masked with & 65535 as most ship-type commands do), same as AP 1721 style.

semantics.summary: Returns the remaining time of the HQ's current repair job.
semantics.returns: int (type 4) = CurrentRepairTime - (age - start); null when idle.
semantics.edge: Not divided by 1000 (unit differs from 1716).

semantics.summary: Tests whether the HQ can repair the given ship.
semantics.params: Boolean = second arg of CanBeRepaired (ignore queue).

commands.syntax: $ret = <RefObj> ->get HQ resources for repair: shiptype=<Var/Ship Type>, percentage=<Var/Number>
commands.text: %1%0get HQ resources for repair: shiptype=%2, percentage=%3

semantics.summary: Returns the resources needed to repair a ship type by the given percentage.
Returns the ship type currently being recycled at the HQ.
semantics.returns: ware (9) main<<16|sub, null if idle or type -1.

semantics.summary: Returns the HQ recycle queue as an array of ships.
semantics.returns: array (21) of ships, null when empty.

semantics.summary: Adds a ship to the HQ recycle queue.
semantics.edge: Only if not already in the recycle queue and CanBeRecycled(ship, 1).

semantics.summary: Removes a ship from the HQ recycle queue.
semantics.edge: No-op if not queued.

semantics.summary: Adds a station (type value) to the HQ recycle queue.
semantics.edge: Identical body to 1726 with a station-type argument; guarded by IsRecycleItem/CanBeRecycled(arg, 1).

semantics.summary: Removes a station (type value) from the HQ recycle queue.
semantics.edge: Identical to 1727.

semantics.summary: Returns the recycle time for a ship type at a given percentage.
semantics.edge: Raw type cell passed (no masking).

semantics.summary: Returns the remaining time of the HQ's current recycle job.
semantics.returns: int (type 4) = CurrentRecycleTime - (age - start); null when idle.
semantics.edge: Not divided by 1000.

semantics.summary: Tests whether the HQ can recycle the given ship.
Returns the resources recovered by recycling a ship/station type at the given percentage.
Returns the ids of the HQ loadouts stored for a ship type.
semantics.params: Only the subtype (& 65535) of the ship type is used.

semantics.summary: Returns the name of an HQ loadout.
Returns the ship type a loadout was created for.
Returns the ids of all HQ loadouts.
Returns the ship types (as wares 7<<16|sub) that have at least one HQ loadout.
semantics.edge: Loops over all subtypes of galaxy class 7. Result is a raw type/value pair array (resultValue = built array).

semantics.summary: Returns the wares a loadout would install.
semantics.params: Flags select categories; a null flag (type 0 or value 0) is replaced by 223.
semantics.edge: Because the test is type==0 || value==0, an explicit flags=0 also becomes 223.

semantics.summary: Creates an HQ loadout for a ship type from a ware table.
Applies a loadout from the HQ to a docked ship.
semantics.returns: int status code (result type 30), 6 if the ship is not docked at this HQ.
semantics.edge: Rejects with 6 unless ship.IsDocked() equals the HQ station. Null or 0 flags become 255.

semantics.summary: Saves a ship's current equipment as a new HQ loadout.
semantics.params: String = loadout name; Number = flags (null/0 -> 255), bit 2 also saves weapon slots, bit 32 saves loadout settings.
semantics.effects: HQ.AddLoadout(name, ship subtype, filtered wares) plus SaveWeaponSlots / SaveLoadoutSettings.

semantics.summary: Checks what applying a loadout to a docked ship would do, without applying it.
semantics.returns: int status code (result type 30), 6 when ship not docked at this HQ.
semantics.edge: Dry-run counterpart of 1749 (CheckLoadout).

semantics.summary: Deletes one HQ loadout by id.
Deletes all HQ loadouts.
Returns the weapon order saved in a loadout.
semantics.returns: array (21) of nested arrays (one per slot) of laser wares (524288|id) or int -1; null if none.

semantics.summary: Sets the weapon order of a loadout.
semantics.params: Array of arrays of ware items (type 21 outer, type 9 inner); only the subtype is stored, -1 appended to each slot.
semantics.edge: Non-array/non-ware entries skipped.

semantics.summary: Finds the id of a loadout by name and ship type.

semantics.summary: Returns the saved settings of an HQ loadout.

semantics.edge: Settings are wrapped into {5: GetLoadoutSettings(id)}.

semantics.summary: Sets the saved settings of a loadout from a script table (key 5).

semantics.summary: Returns the resupply table of a loadout (wares to keep stocked).

semantics.summary: Sets the HQ's maximum storage limit for a ware type.

semantics.summary: Returns the blueprint production time for a type.

semantics.params: Boolean: true = ignore whether the HQ has blueprints.

semantics.summary: Returns the number of output units of one blueprint run (1 when the HQ has the blueprint).

semantics.summary: Returns the blueprint count constant used for blueprint operations (always 100).
semantics.edge: Ignores its argument.

semantics.summary: Returns the ships in the HQ that can be recycled.

semantics.summary: Returns the station-type wares held by the HQ that can be recycled.
semantics.returns: table (29) ware->ware (keys of main type 5 or 6 owned by the HQ), null if none.
semantics.edge: Loops over the HQ's owned-ship table entries whose main type is 5 or 6; field name is probably misnamed.

commands.syntax: $ret =|if <RefObj> -> get user input: type=<Script Reference Type>, title=<Var/String>

semantics.summary: Opens a user-input menu so the player picks an object/value of the given reference type; waits until the player answers or the menu closes.
semantics.returns: Selected (type,value) from the menu; if the menu returns a 2-element array it is unpacked; null if no menu was opened
semantics.params: RefObj = command console object; Script Reference Type = what to pick (cell value passed to the menu); String = title
semantics.edge: RefObj null/nonexistent: the active monitor control object, else the player ship, is used. Not opened when a message box is open or another menu would conflict (already an active menu: chained as next menu). Sector for the dialog: explicit (1537 only), else the object if it is a sector, else the object's sector, else the player's sector. Polls every 200 ms.
semantics.bug: Opens only when client state == 0 ('!state & 1'), S3 known.

Not opened when a message box is open or another menu would conflict (already an active menu: chained as next menu). Sector for the dialog: explicit (1537 only), else the object if it is a sector, else the object's sector, else the player's sector.
semantics.bug: Opens only when client state == 0 ('!state & 1'), S3 known. Also 'without sector' passes the same sector computation and the same flag value 1 as 1537 (flag = cmdId != 1329), so it is not obviously different from 1537 in the handler.
